svg.title: Attendance, invoice and chat · iPhone and Android
svg.desc: Six static work-screen schematics. An excused attendance row is locked; an invoice shows four independent copy controls; an official conversation keeps its composer above the keyboard. All examples use synthetic records.
svg.text: Lock state, copy actions and a keyboard-aware composer stay visible at the point of use.

g.text: Only an authorized arrival can reopen an excused row
Four separately selectable values · fictitious transfer data
Reply context and composer above the system keyboard
